registered_at: 2026-11-14 America/Los_Angeles, after the evaluation was opened
classification: Post-hoc descriptive audit registration, not a preregistered forecasting experiment
inputs: Already public saved reports and matched trace analysis only. No new benchmark inputs, no November 7–13 competition truth, no current market sources as historical features.

scientific_improvements.weakness: Pooled pinball alone hides interval coverage/width tradeoffs and tiny denominators.
scientific_improvements.hypothesis: Comparing coverage, width and denominators will expose whether a lower-loss selected checkpoint also has a useful uncertainty tradeoff; this is descriptive, not a significance test.
scientific_improvements.acceptance: Covered cells reconstruct stored coverage exactly; all widths/pinball values match reports, with per-horizon/series detail and starting-policy reference.
scientific_improvements.cutoff: The existing retrospective August 29/September 5/12 evaluation; values already exposed. No fitting or recalibration.
scientific_improvements.negative_result: Poor coverage or wider intervals remain visible; 80% nominal coverage is not claimed as a validated population rate.

scientific_improvements.weakness: A forecast-loss tie can be incorrectly described as a static action policy, or changed behaviour as useful learning.
scientific_improvements.hypothesis: Matched saved trajectories can separate changed actions, final choices and forecast loss; a changed sequence may leave the final outcome unchanged.
scientific_improvements.acceptance: Counts use existing matched analysis by run ID; missing analyses are null/pending rather than zero. The final validation chooser remains explicit.
scientific_improvements.cutoff: The same already opened evaluation; no extra trials or altered observations.
scientific_improvements.negative_result: Action sensitivity without loss improvement limits the incremental utility claim.

scientific_improvements.weakness: Equal six-result budgets can be mistaken for equal total computation, spending or independent evidence.
scientific_improvements.hypothesis: Separately accounting for cached reveals, weight updates and fresh executions makes resource claims assessable.
scientific_improvements.acceptance: Completed reports and operational receipts supply each count. In-progress updates are not folded into completed-report totals.
scientific_improvements.cutoff: Current execution receipts; no current sources enter historical numerical inputs.
scientific_improvements.negative_result: An equal reveal count does not establish compute or cost competitiveness.

execution.execution: Small CPU projection in the existing Modal web application and remote Actions validation
execution.cost: Serving/validation charges are not individually attributed; no measured zero-cost claim

first_validation.note: One observed HTTP roundtrip, including network/serving overhead; not a CPU throughput benchmark

product_improvements: Coherent paper-and-ink SVG notebook with self-hosted licensed handwriting for short annotations
Source-bound margin note, movable time ruler and immutable session pins
Study notes exposing coverage, feedback utility and separate resource ledgers
remaining_evidence: Independent periods, more eligible contracts and matured prospective outcomes are needed for stronger forecasting/generalization claims.
